name: CBIS-DDSM: Curated Breast Imaging Subset of DDSM
description: The Curated Breast Imaging Subset of the Digital Database for Screening Mammography (CBIS-DDSM) is an updated and standardized benchmark dataset for computer-aided detection and diagnosis in screening mammography. Hosted on The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA), CBIS-DDSM includes 2,620 scanned film mammography studies across 1,566 participants (3,568 total images). Selected and verified by expert radiologists, the dataset decompresses and standardizes the original DDSM data into DICOM format, updates the pathology ground truth (normal, benign, and malignant), and provides bounding boxes and pixel-level region-of-interest (ROI) segmentation masks for both breast masses and microcalcifications alongside BI-RADS assessment descriptors.
